exclusions.theorem: No Spark or other live provider is admitted by this semantic slice without externally anchored runtime/provider evidence; unavailable evidence yields UNAVAILABLE or typed remand before dispatch.

DSS-0.5 produces advisory results only and contains no UI, institutional wakeup, commissioning, promotion, or activation operation.

operations.atomicity: one expected replicate-slot reservation and attempt-lineage row commit atomically

operations.atomicity: adapter/runtime assurance, request dispatch boundary, and attempt START event share one terminal CAS boundary

operations.atomicity: raw bytes publish to private quarantine before any ordinary reference and exact attempt terminal winner commit

operations.atomicity: quarantine digest, canonical schema, capsule/attempt/page bindings, and response publication commit together
operations.replay: same raw custody and validator receipts return original canonical response; failed raw output cannot be retried into admission

operations.atomicity: usage, transport interruption, and raw-result lineage record in one append-only accounting transaction

operations.atomicity: complete visible attempt/result population and frozen evaluation policy are read at one evaluation boundary

operations.atomicity: terminal coverage, evaluations, usage, and all attempt lineage seal in one immutable disposition transaction

operations.atomicity: cancellation compares the exact attempt dispatch boundary and records the winning terminal event

operations.atomicity: authenticated event-ledger verification and full population reconstruction precede recovery disposition publication
operations.replay: same ledger head and source populations replay; unknown dispatch, missing quarantine, or digest mismatch blocks without new attempt

semantic_laws.slice: DSS-0.4 exact closed-page projection -> one worker runtime and isolated model-adapter boundary -> advisory output
semantic_laws.identity: all identity values are externally anchored or content-addressed; names-only, labels, paths, provider ids, prompts, and aggregate counts cannot establish identity
semantic_laws.custody: runtime, adapter, capsule, request, attempt, raw quarantine, canonical response, usage, evaluation, disposition, and recovery records carry exact source/custody digests
semantic_laws.currentness: DSS-0.4 service generation, page/batch/seal and both runtime revisions are joined at the same admission latch; stale values fail closed
semantic_laws.authority: only owner-issued runtime/adapter descriptors and exact per-operation capability intersections may advance state; every worker/model result has authorityEffect=none
semantic_laws.providerSelection: ADMITTED_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE_ONLY; Spark and every live provider are explicitly UNAVAILABLE/DEFERRED until an externally anchored runtime/provider evidence record exists
semantic_laws.request: canonical request is derived from capsule and adapter mapping; raw prompt, credential, endpoint, provider continuation, and caller-authored request bodies are excluded
semantic_laws.attemptLineage: attemptRef is unique per replicate slot and process invocation; every retryable failure is predeclared; admitted result statuses are never silently retried
semantic_laws.rawCustody: raw provider output enters private quarantine before ordinary reference; structural/binding rejection remains visible and cannot become canonical output
semantic_laws.cancellation: prospective only; exact compare-and-swap winner remains authoritative and unknown dispatch blocks cancellation/retry
semantic_laws.replay: same canonical request and source custody return the original receipt; any changed digest, policy, runtime, adapter, page, or lineage yields idempotency conflict or stale rejection
semantic_laws.recovery: recovery recomputes status, reason, authority effect, source receipt digests, and every carrier/transition/outcome population from the authenticated event ledger; unequal or missing source blocks
semantic_laws.effects: advisory only; no project mutation, kernel mutation, route mutation, authority grant, provider truth, UI handoff, or promotion

attempt_policy.providerRetryStanding: NO_ADMITTED_RESULT_OR_TERMINAL_FAILURE_IS_RETRIED; only predeclared retryable classes may open a new attempt under a new attemptRef

predecessor.acceptance: field-for-field equality of page, materialization, completeness, sufficiency, batch seal, service generation, and projection revision

exclusions_law.noLiveProvider: provider/model selection remains deferred until runtime evidence; no credentials/network use is admitted
exclusions_law.noRepository: worker sees exact closed page only
